_comment: Tier-2: the compressible-potential freestream variables are FREE_STREAM_VELOCITY / FREE_STREAM_MACH (two words, underscore-separated) and live on CompressiblePotentialFlowApplication, not on core. Pitfall (kratos.compressible_potential #1) instructs the reader to 'set FREESTREAM_VELOCITY and MACH_INFINITY'. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). BOTH OF THOSE NAMES ARE FALSE: neither resolves on CPF nor on KM. The real names do. This fixture pins the correction. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
